name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill
description: Dev-time minimal functional stand-in for @mstar-harness/dsh. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub mirrors the consumed contract surface of the skill provider registry (`ctx.skills` — summary/candidate/definition shapes, the provider interface) and implements just enough behavior for real-composition tests (provider registration with fiber-scoped disposal, first-wins catalog merging, on-demand loading). Mirrors dsh-private commit 9451be2 (2026-08-07 snapshot).
